claim: STORIS NextGen Mobile POS lets associates send a Manager Override Authorization Request to a manager's device by text, with margin impact visible before approval; enterprise furniture ERP, quote-priced
value: Remote text approval exists; price quote-only (third-party est. $200-500/user/mo + setup)

claim: Furniture Wizard shows instant profit, margin and markup at POS, prints cost cyphers on tags, has role permissions and an iPad app; no approval workflow, floor price, or AI; price unpublished
value: Margin math at POS yes; floor/approval no

claim: Myriad PointCentric serves one to twelve showrooms; quoting with pricing on one screen and order approval tracking; no discount floor, margin-at-POS or remote approval described; quote pricing
PROFITsystems RETAILvantage offers per-item dollar/percent discounting and field-level privilege levels with change tracking; no remote approval; quote pricing; historically $1M-$80M retailers
value: Per-item discounting + privileges; no floor/remote approval

claim: FROG (furnguy.com) is a budget furniture POS with a web/mobile app for sales entry and item lookup; no discount, margin or approval controls described; price unpublished
value: Mobile app yes; floor/approval not described

claim: Genesis Advantage is an on-premise Windows inventory/accounting system for small-to-mid furniture retailers; vendor site not found; quote pricing; discount/margin features unconfirmed

RetailVista (NedFox, NL/UK garden centres), Bravo Business Media (eCatalog for decorative showrooms, Unilog since 2021), iDeal, Furniture Hub and DealerChoice are not US independent-furniture POS competitors; the last three were not found
Clientbook is a clienteling CRM for jewelry and furniture at about $295/month (third-party figure); AI product recommendations, no pricing or discount approval features

Shopify POS 'Apply custom discounts' permission is allowed / denied / approval required (manager PIN on device); no percentage cap or price floor; profit reports compute gross profit and margin from cost per item; POS Pro $89 per location per month

Square for Retail needs the Plus plan for unit costs, COGS and Margin and Projected Profit reports; discounts can be passcode-restricted at the register; no floor price or remote approval; Plus ~ $89/location/mo per third-party guides
value: Plus plan required for margin reports; ~89 (third-party)

claim: Lightspeed Retail X-Series costs $89 / $149 / $289 per month with custom user roles and landed-cost margins on all plans; a discount can be flagged 'Requires manager' (code entered at register); margin by employee is an after-the-fact report; no per-item floor or percentage cap

Clover roles are Admin / Manager / Employee / custom per third-party guides; discount caps, manager approval for discounts and item-cost reporting are unconfirmed (vendor pages unparseable); price via reseller quote

Pricing-intelligence platforms are online competitor-scraping tools: Prisync $99-$799/mo, Omnia SMB from EUR 399/mo, Competera/Pricefx/Wiser/Minderest/Intelligence Node enterprise quote (Pricefx ~ $100k/yr third-party); none built for showroom negotiation or exposes a floor to floor staff; no small brick-and-mortar furniture use found
value: Prisync 99-799; Omnia from 399 EUR; others quote

claim: B2B deal desk / CPQ tools enforce per-SKU floors and tiered discount approvals (DealHub example: reps not below $80, managers not below $70 on $100 list; Salesforce Revenue Cloud $150-$200/user/month with email-reply approvals) but target SaaS sales teams, not store floors

Closest workflow analog is Roadster Express Desking (car dealers, Oct 2018; CDK since June 2021): salesperson messages terms to a desk manager who approves non-standard terms remotely, on mobile, while the salesperson stays with the customer; vAuto is inventory pricing only
value: Remote desk-manager approval exists in auto retail since 2018
source_title: Roadster aims to smooth out salesperson-to-desk manager communication

claim: Generic POS add-ons sell the pieces separately: Odoo per-user discount limits with manager approval (~$50 one-time), NRS Plus Remote Manager Override from a merchant app ($9.95/mo add-on on a $19.95/mo plan), Profit Guard min-margin discount blocking for Shopify online ($0-$29.99/mo); none furniture-aware or combined

Customer-facing AI haggle bots (Nibble $499/mo + 2% above $24,950 in sales; BargainIt) negotiate with online shoppers within merchant-set limits and cite furniture e-commerce clients; none runs between a human salesperson and customer in a showroom

Electronic shelf labels cost about $5-$20 per tag plus a $300-$400 gateway and ~$500 software plus SaaS; furniture adoption is limited to giants (Nebraska Furniture Mart ~30,000 tags, 2014) and pilots (Möbel Heinrich accessories area, 2025); small showrooms with few, negotiated, seasonally priced items rarely adopt
source_title: How much do electronic shelf labels cost

claim: No product found that gives an independent brick-and-mortar store a per-item minimum acceptable price computed from cost/age/delivery, a suggested counteroffer for the salesperson, and one-tap owner approval from a phone; nearest is STORIS NextGen (enterprise) plus auto-dealer desking and B2B deal desks
